text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, with the Takarazuka Kinen drawing near.
Just as I was finishing up work to head home—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Ines's Trainer,
found ya~~☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to bother you, but...
do you mind hanging out with us for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Led by the two of them to a nearby family restaurant.
Waiting there were the convenience store coworkers
Ines Fujin works with.

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text: You two finally maaaade it~~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume & Gals
text_block_list.text: Waaaay☆
choice_data_list: Do you two know each other?
Do you all know each other?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
When I went to Ines's race earlier,
she was right next to me!
Like, majorly hyping up the vibes with a collab, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So, Ines is running in the Takarazuka Kinen, right?
We were talking about throwing a send-off party with this group on our next day off.

text_block_list.name: False-Eyelash Gal
text_block_list.text:
"Then Ines's Trainer is totally a must-have too, right?"
So yeah!
I'd seriously appreciate it if you could help out~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I want Ines Fuujin to fully recharge her energy for the next race. The offer of a send-off party was exactly what I had hoped for.
choice_data_list: If it's something I can do, I'd be happy to!
If it's something I can do, I'd be happy to help!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Let's all hype Ines up!
FOOOOOO~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Now then, let's pray for Ines's victory~~?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume & Gals
text_block_list.text: Cheeeers!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing! Thank you so much
for preparing all this just for me!

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
Don't be a stranger! Today's our treat,
so just relax, Ines!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Wah! That is quite reassuring♪
choice_data_list: (Alright, I've gotta pitch in and help out too—!)
(Alright, I need to make sure I help out too—!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I rented it for now, but how do you turn it on? This marshmallow roaster...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah! In that case, I used one at my part-time job at the campsite!
Let me try!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, welcome☆ Pretty insane, right?
I went and bought the biggest one in the shop!

text_block_list.name: False-Eyelash Gal
text_block_list.text:
Creepy, that's crazy.
Wait, can anyone even cook that?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: At that size, it might be better to fillet it into five pieces. Mind if I borrow the knife for a sec?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I tried searing some fish fillets in the marshmallow roaster!
Line up in an orderly fashion if you'd like some~~♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume & Gals
text_block_list.text: Waaaay☆

text_block_list.name: False-Eyelash Gal
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, no no no! Ines is the star today!
It'd defeat the whole point if we made her work!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"You don't need to worry about it at all.
In fact, I'm the one who wants to help out~."
choice_data_list: It's a rare day off, so you should take it eas—
It's a rare day off, so please, take it eas—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Geez! It's our day off, which is why
I don't wanna be the only one left out!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You know... sharing fun times with others
feels like receiving a treasure in your heart.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Filled with sparkling memories.
Looking at them gives me peace of mind.
And makes me feel like, "I can keep giving it my best."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to have a BBQ too.
Together with "everyone" who cheers me on!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I wuv this~~! "With everyone" is pure love!
Alright! Let's get this BBQ back on track!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: “Yeah. We'll do our best too, so Ines, could we ask you to take the lead?”

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "Leave it to me! We'll combine our strength and throw an epic BBQ!"

text_block_list.name: Ines & Gals
text_block_list.text: Ayyâ Ayyâ Oooohhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Thanks to assigning suitable roles to each person, the BBQ was a roaring success, and Ines Fujin had a wonderful time."
